'''Savić''' ({{IPA|sh|sǎːʋitɕ|pron}}; {{Cyrl|Савич, Савiч}}), '''Savich''' or '''Savitch''' is a [[Slavs|Slavic]] surname, sometimes used as a first name, most common among [[South Slavs]]. It can be related to the name [[Sava (name)|Sava]] or [[Sava|Sava (river)]].

Notable people with the surname include:

__TOC__
